umi8_5-L0001.text: I became the Halloween party princess, and the tournament of quizzes and riddles just for me began. It looks like I get a medal for each puzzle I get right. If I get a lot, I'm supposed to get a wonderful prize from Grandfather.
runs: I became the Halloween party princess,
and the tournament of quizzes and riddles just for me began.
It looks like I get a medal for each puzzle I get right.
If I get a lot, I'm supposed to get a wonderful prize from Grandfather.

umi8_5-L0007.text: "I don't think it matters. Start with whomever you like."
umi8_5-L0007.speaker: Ushiromiya Eva

umi8_5-L0009.text: "I'd better think up a killer puzzle while I have the chance."
runs: "I'd better think up a killer puzzle while I have the chance."
umi8_5-L0009.speaker: Ushiromiya Rudolf

umi8_5-L0010.text: "Maria, didn't you have a quiz book in your bag?"
runs: "Maria, didn't you have a quiz book in your bag?"
umi8_5-L0010.speaker: Ushiromiya Rosa

umi8_5-L0011.text: "Uu-! I do! Kihihihihihi, I'm gonna give Ange a nasty one...!"
runs: Kihihihihihi, I'm gonna give Ange a nasty one...!"
umi8_5-L0011.speaker: Ushiromiya Maria

umi8_5-L0013.text: Maria onee-chan laughed with an evil smile. Looks like everyone's going to try and bully me. I'm sure they'll think up some really hard questions.
runs: Maria onee-chan laughed with an evil smile.
Looks like everyone's going to try and bully me.
I'm sure they'll think up some really hard questions.

umi8_5-L0018.text: "Of course. After all, I'm the princess's attendant. So, let's give it our all together and get a huge pile of medals."
runs: After all, I'm the princess's attendant.
So, let's give it our all together and get a huge pile of medals."
umi8_5-L0018.speaker: Ushiromiya Eva

umi8_5-L0022.text: "Come now, Ange-sama. Start wherever you want. I, Gohda, am ready to challenge you whenever you please."
runs: I, Gohda, am ready to challenge you whenever you please."
umi8_5-L0022.speaker: Gohda Toshiro

umi8_5-L0025.text: "Whoa, not so fast. The honor of the first audience with the princess belongs to me. Ange, begin with my challenge...!"
runs: The honor of the first audience with the princess belongs to me.
umi8_5-L0025.speaker: Ushiromiya Kinzo

umi8_5-L0029.text: I suddenly got tense, and my stomach began to feel tight. Then, Aunt Eva gently held my hand.
runs: I suddenly got tense, and my stomach began to feel tight.
Then, Aunt Eva gently held my hand.

umi8_5-L0031.text: "It'll be okay. Let's do this together!"
umi8_5-L0031.speaker: Ushiromiya Eva

umi8_5-L0034.text: "Then let us begin, Ange. This is a story about December 25th, Christmas Day."
runs: This is a story about December 25th, Christmas Day."
umi8_5-L0034.speaker: Ushiromiya Kinzo

umi8_5-L0037.text: Even though it was October, he suddenly started talking about Christmas. Is he going to ask what day Christmas is? I know that. It's December 25th.
runs: Even though it was October, he suddenly started talking about Christmas.
Is he going to ask what day Christmas is?

umi8_5-L0041.text: "On Christmas Day, a woman looked up at the night sky and spoke: "Eventually, the night will end, and morning will come. Wouldn't it be wonderful if, after the sun sinks and it becomes night once more, it could be Christmas again?" And then, the man spoke. "Okay, I'll make your dream come true for you." Is such a thing possible...?"
runs: a woman looked up at the night sky and spoke:
"Eventually, the night will end, and morning will come.
Wouldn't it be wonderful if, after the sun sinks and it becomes night once more, it could be Christmas again?"
I'll make your dream come true for you."
umi8_5-L0041.speaker: Ushiromiya Kinzo

umi8_5-L0049.text: "The day after Christmas is the 26th, a normal day. That's impossible."
runs: "The day after Christmas is the 26th, a normal day.
umi8_5-L0049.speaker: Ushiromiya Ange

umi8_5-L0051.text: "...Still Christmas, even after the sun rises... Oh, I've got it."
runs: "...Still Christmas, even after the sun rises...
umi8_5-L0051.speaker: Ushiromiya Eva

umi8_5-L0053.text: "Huh? How?! How can the day after Christmas be Christmas again?!"
runs: How can the day after Christmas be Christmas again?!"
umi8_5-L0053.speaker: Ushiromiya Ange

umi8_5-L0055.text: "Wahhahahahaha. Think about it for yourself, Ange."
runs: Think about it for yourself, Ange."
umi8_5-L0055.speaker: Ushiromiya Kinzo
